findings.evidence: grep for id_toLinearMap/comp_toLinearMap in TauCeti/ returns only the unrelated ComoduleCat bundled versions (Cat.lean:177,183); no such lemma exists for Comodule.Hom, so the defeq is inlined at lines 426-427 and 440-441.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem Hom.id_toLinearMap : (id R C M).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := rfl` and `@[simp] theorem Hom.comp_toLinearMap : (g.comp f).toLinearMap = g.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap := rfl` to the Hom API in Comodule/Basic.lean (mirroring the existing `coe_toLinearMap`), then rewrite with those named lemmas here instead of `show … from rfl`.
findings.issue: tensorMap_id (lines 426-427) and tensorMap_comp (lines 440-441) each use inline `show (id R C M).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id from rfl` / `show (f'.comp f).toLinearMap = f'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap from rfl`. These rest on unfolding the `Hom.toLinearMap` projection of `id`/`comp` — an undocumented definitional equality across the Hom wrapper — and inline a reusable fact instead of naming it.

summary: Proofs are generally robust (ext + induction + simp) and well-commented. The exception: tensorMap_id and tensorMap_comp rely on inline `show (…).toLinearMap = … from rfl` to unfold the Hom.toLinearMap projection of `id`/`comp`, an undocumented defeq that also hides a reusable API fact.
